mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.house_id, f.create_time, h.id AS h_id, h.title AS h_title, h.type AS h_type, h.district AS h_district, h.bedrooms AS h_bedrooms, h.bathrooms AS h_bathrooms, h.area AS h_area, h.price AS h_price, h.orientation AS h_orientation, h.floor AS h_floor, h.decoration AS h_decoration, h.lease_term AS h_lease_term, h.tags AS h_tags, h.address AS h_address, h.description AS h_description, h.image AS h_image, h.landlord_id AS h_landlord_id, h.status AS h_status, h.views AS h_views FROM favorites f INNER JOIN house h ON f.house_id = h.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND h.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.house_id, f.create_time, h.id AS h_id, h.title AS h_title, h.type AS h_type, h.district AS h_district, h.bedrooms AS h_bedrooms, h.bathrooms AS h_bathrooms, h.area AS h_area, h.price AS h_price, h.orientation AS h_orientation, h.floor AS h_floor, h.decoration AS h_decoration, h.lease_term AS h_lease_term, h.tags AS h_tags, h.address AS h_address, h.description AS h_description, h.image AS h_image, h.landlord_id AS h_landlord_id, h.status AS h_status, h.views AS h_views FROM favorites f INNER JOIN house h ON f.house_id = h.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.house_id = #{houseId} AND h.is_deleted = 0
